tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ rab gnas mdor bsdus cung zad rgyas par spro na/ rten gsar pa'i drung mchod pa sna tshogs gang 'byor dang*/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bus brgyan pa sogs bkod la/ las bum bca' zhing*/ gos zung 'dag chal sogs dang*/ 'thor nas/ yungs kar/ gu gul/ sbyang chas rnams bcas 'du bar byas nas/ dang po gsol 'debs gang 'os dang/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs lan gsum re/ de ltar skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ las bum bskyed chog ni/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ las bum mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las// rin chen las grub mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus// pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig las// khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku yi mdog /ljang sngon phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang*// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub khro chas yongs su rdzogs// thugs kar nyi dkyil lte bar hūm̐ yig gi /mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ khro bo khyed kyis bgegs bzlog mdzad nas ni// 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i bum pa gang par gyur// snyam du bsam/ de nas me tog byin rlabs ni/ 'bru rnams rten 'brel gyi yig 'bru'i rang bzhin du gyur/ par bsam la/ oṃ na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mo sad+gha ya/ oṃ ye dharma sogs brgya'am nyer gcig bzlas la/ byin rlabs bya/ yungs kar la/ yungs kar khro bo'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= sum bha ni sbrel ma bdun na ma nyer gcig brjod par phus gdab/ de nas rten gsar pa rnams kyi drung du sbyong gtor bshams la/ oṃ a kā ro yis byin brlabs/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba sogs kyis zhi sbyang/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba sogs dang*/ sum bha ni sbrel mas zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang mthar/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs zhi drag phyed mas sbyang bar 'os pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang gnas su song shig

/gal te mi 'gro ba de dag rdo rje me lces brlag par 'gyur ro// zhes kyang brjod de phyir btang*/ de nas drag pos sbyong ba ni/ lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par gyur/ dril stabs dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsregs// zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po'i dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs su gsol// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod phyir gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngams stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la= lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la= bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyis sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung bsregs par mdzad la= gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la= hūm̐/

'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs can// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir rab tu gnas par byed// khyod rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgya ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// nas bka' bsgos nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sum bha ni sogs brjod cing rten gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab la bgegs bskrad bya/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas sdig sbyangs ni/ snying khar kaṃ las sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo sdig pa'i gzugs su gyur pa lte bar hūm̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur pa'i sna sgo'i lam nas ded cing mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pa paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mer bsreg /g.yon du rgya mtsho chen por dor bas byang zhing dag par gyur/ ces brjod la phyir dor/ de nas rten rnams la las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ a mṛ ta sogs/ swa bha wa sa/ stong pa'i ngang las rten rnams skad cig gis// seng ge'i khri mchog mtho zhing rgya che'i steng*// pad zla'i gdan la bstan pa'i bdag po mchog /gser sbyangs btso ma'i mdog las lhag pa'i mchog /mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cus spras// phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon pas mnyam bzhag mdzad// ngur smrig rnam gsum na bza'i rgyan gyis mdzes// 'od kyis stong gsum khyab pa de'i dpral bar// oṃ dang mgrin par āḥste thugs kar hūm̐// gis mtshan de las 'od 'phros ye shes sems// thogs med spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

de nas thams cad 'greng ste gus pa chen pos spos rol dang bcas te/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon sogs nas/ gshegs su gsol/ bar/ ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams ni dga' ldan na// sprul pa dam pa tog dkar lha yi bus// mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas// gzigs pa rnam bzhis 'dzam bu'i gling gzigs te// glang chen thal dkar ltar gshegs lhums zhugs nas// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma'i rigs mchog dang*// las kyi rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// dus 'dir bdag gi dad pas spyan 'dren nas// rten mchog 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// lan bdun nam nyer gcig brjod do// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// sogs/ bzhugs su gsol/ bar/ stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa'ang brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon de dag las// 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag yar lud rnam snang dbu brgyan pa'i// dpral bar oṃ dkar mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ yig de dag mtshan par gyur// zhes brjod cing spyan dbye ba'i dmigs pas/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod/ skabs 'dir khrus gsol cung zad rgyas par spro na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/

bde bar gshegs pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bdag gis yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ 'dag chal byug / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta = sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga sogs/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol pas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha ni hūm̐/ rgyas par na/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyang mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus gsol lo// na maḥsarba ta thā ga= 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma= tshul khrims dri yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis = 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin= khong khro'i dri ma= bzod pa dri yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis= 'di ni brtson 'grus rang = le lo'i dri ma= brtson 'grus dri yis= khrus legs=

'di ni bsam gtan= rnam g.yeng dri ma= bsam gtan dri yis= khrus legs mdzad= 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin= shes 'chal dri ma sbyang= shes rab dri yis legs= khrus legs mdzad kyis = na maḥsarba ta thā= sogs/ chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyang nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' ba'i// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyang mdzad cing*// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// sngags brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par gang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā sogs brjod/ ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha= chos la phyag 'tshal deng = sems can gang dag= de dag thams cad= tshogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod= dge 'dun= nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i// dkon mchog gsum gyi bde legs shog / gos zung 'bul la/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis bas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus kun bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃḥhūm̐ḥtrāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes brjod cing khrus ras la sa bon de lnga mtshon byed kyi dri yi thig le lnga byas la/ ka ya bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na gza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐/

srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐/ lhag bsam dag pa'i na bza' 'di phul bas// lus la ngur smrig gos gyon sems la ni// ngo tsha khrel yod bzod pa'i gos gyon nas// rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog / ces brjod par bya'o// maṇ+ḍal ni/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges pa kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs/ sogs tshang bar 'don/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// bar/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma yā/ sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa sogs tshang bar brjod/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes dang/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs/ rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / zhes dang/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus la// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya dang*// bye ba 'bum dang dung phyur te// maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bsdus nas ni// mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po sogs/ 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / bar ro// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten du ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang po'i gzeb las grol// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags sogs nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ rigs sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la mchog tu rgya chen po byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa las mngon par mtho ba'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rab tu 'phro bar gyur cig /na maḥsarba budha bodhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/

zhes lan brgyad bton la byin brlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma yā+e hūm̐/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med= zhabs bsil ji= bdag gis gus/ rgyal ba sras= na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pad+yaṃ pra= 'jig rten khams ni dpag= me tog= bdag gis= rgyal ba= na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe= 'jig rten khams ni dpag= bdug spos= bdag gis= rgyal ba sras dang = na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe= 'jig rten khams ni dpag= snang gsal= bdag gis= rgyal ba= na maḥsarba thā ga ta a lo kai= 'jig rten khams ni dpag med= dri chab= bdag gis= rgyal ba sras= na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe= 'jig rten khams ni dpag= zhal zas ji= bdag gis gus= rgyal ba sras dang = na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wid+ya= 'jig rten khams ni dpag= sgra snyan ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shab+da pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha= zhes rkang 'thon du 'bul/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su sam̐ gra ha/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma le traṃ/ rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pas/ oṃ badz+ra dharma kā ya ni/ oṃ badz+ra gī rti hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra karma ka rod+gha we/ oṃ badz+ra nṛt+ye āḥ de bzhin du/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na// oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐/ rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pas// oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par gyur// o badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ bcas sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkres shing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ni rat+na= btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta s+t+rī rat+na= blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu ru ṣa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hasti rat+na= rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tu rad+ga a shwa rat+na= dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khad+ga rat+na pū dzi= rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya pad+ma dung// bum pa dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo ste// lha yi dga' tshal mdzes par byed pa yi// bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams ni 'bul bar bgyi// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta aṣ+ṭa he tu mad+ga la pra tī ts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams phul/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā mā gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos= bzhes nas= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+da= phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos= bzhes nas= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rgyal= bzhes nas= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ra sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos rgyal= bzhes nas bla med= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta spar+she pra tits+tsha= sogs 'dod yon lngas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku// rgyal ba nyi ma 'od zer stong gi 'od// rgyal ba pad+ma dri ma med pa'i spyan// rgyal ba me tog pad rtsa rdul med tshems// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu ste// rin po che ni du ma'i 'byung gnas gyur// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes chu yis gang*// ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong gis kun tu gang*// rgyal ba'i zhabs ni 'khor lo bris pa ste// khor yug mu khyud de bzhin rtsibs ma stong*// phyag dang zhabs ni drwa bas spras pa ste// zhabs kyi drwa ba ngang pa'i dbang po bzhin// gser gyi ri bo lta bur rab tu gda'// rgyal ba dri med gser gyi ri dbang po// yon tan thams cad ri dbang 'dra ba ste// sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba chu zla 'dra// nam mkha' dang yang mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste// sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bur chags pa med// rgyal ba dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo//

bstod pa dang*/ yang na/ mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen chen khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo sgyur mdzad cing*// kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs// dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas// mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*// gang du byang chub la reg dang*// zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// zag med mya ngan 'das pa dang*// bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*// 'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// sed+ge lta bur gzims pa yi// gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*// skur bcas sku ni med pa yi// mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// bstod phyag 'bul bar bya'o// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad pa// bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol// bcom ldan thub pa chen po nyid// ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa'i// 'gro ba sems can mtha' dag ni// mi gnas myang 'das ma thob par// brtan par bzhugs nas bye brag tu// 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas ma gos par// brtan par mdzad de bzhugs su gsol// lan gsum brjod/ de nas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i rnam par gyur// par bsam la gsung rten dang gsung rab sogs gsang gsum rten rnams de bzhin du gyur par bsam nas/

de nas rten rnams la byin gyis brlab/ me tog 'thor la/ oṃ na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mo sad+gā ya/ oṃ ye dharma he tu pra= oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus brjod/ mthar/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams/ 'bru dang tha dad med par byon nas rten so so la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur// par mos la/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi khyim bdag des pa la gsungs te bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid brjod par bya'o// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med// dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge bdun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba// rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis// phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te// bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog / gzhan yang bkra shis dang*/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i sogs/ rgya gar paṇa chen sogs/ 'jig rten 'dren sogs/ bdag gi tshe rabs sogs/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs/ dus gsum rgyal ba sogs/ shes bya'i mkha' la sogs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi sogs/ phyogs bcur bzhugs sogs/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud sogs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sogs/ zab cing rgya che sogs/ 'bad dang rtsol ba sogs/ 'byung po gang dag sogs/ gnas skabs su yang

sogs/ lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston sogs/ bsod nams ri bo sogs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi sogs/ gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs sogs/ skabs thob rgyas bsdus gang bde brjod par bya'o// de nas bsngo smon ni/ sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa ni// rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu'i mchog de yin// sbyin pa'i bdag pos bskrun pa'i bzo bo bcas// 'di nas byang chub snying po ma thob par// bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyis rjes bzung ste// thog med nas bsags thar pa'i gegs gyur pa// bdag 'dzin sgrib tshogs sprin gyis rab 'thums te// ma nor lam ston rtsa ba'i bla ma yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig phyi nang gsang*// nyi shu rtsa bdun dang ni so so thar// byang sems tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab// gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig che// 'gal nyams ltung ba mtha' dag ci mchis pa// snying nas 'gyod sems drag pos mthol zhing bshags// rgyal bstan mchog las gzhan stong dbu ma'i lam// nyams len mthar phyin bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel// tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor lang tsho rgyas// dus gsum dge tshogs gcig tu bzlums byas nas// mkha' mnyam ma rgan byang chub chen por bsngo// de ltar dge tshogs 'bras bzang yon tan las// bag chags rnam rtog rgyun chad ye shes kyi// gnas lugs khor mo yug tu 'char ba yis// 'gro kun thar pa'i lam du 'dren byed pa'i// bslu med ded dpon mchog tu gyur par shog /gzhan yang 'jig rten khams 'dir rtag pa ru// nad mug 'khrugs rtsod ming yang mi grags shing*// char chu dus 'babs lo 'bras phun tshogs rgyas// thams cad bsam don chos bzhin yongs 'grub shog /na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ tad+ya thā/ pañca pri ya a wa bho ta na ya swā hā/ rjes chog gi mchod bstod ni/ dang po mchod pa ni/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa'i bdug mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod pa bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi//

bstod pa rgyas pa byas na/ mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can// thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i chos mchog can// yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de// dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin// dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol// rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gags pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gags par yong mi 'gyur// e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yang dag yon tan rgyas pa ste// lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*// gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bsdu na/ bstod pa 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang sogs/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum la sogs/ chos dbyings byang chub sems dkyil 'khor du// bdag sogs sogs brjod par bya'o// zhes pa 'di shākya'i dge slong karma pa bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rjes gnas mdo ba'i dge bshes lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i mnga' bdag shes bya la blo gros rgyas pa ste/

de phyir yon tan blo gros zhes byas bskul pa'i don bzhin chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la mnyam med thub pa mchog gis chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la bris pa shu bha puṣ+ṭiṃ/ de ltar rgyal mchog bcu gsum pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas byin rlabs char 'bebs kyi zhal rgyun lta bu cung zad rgyas pa rang gzhan kun la sman ched/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa 'gal ba mchis na dag tshangs stsol// dge bas bstan 'gro bkra shis stsol// mad+ga lam/// /
